name: A same-session world-entry notice inside the resend cooldown is still answered (#5737, #6394)
contract: The client keeps the server's SMSG_PATCH_SPELL rows only for the world entry that received them, so
every world entry - the first, a loading screen and a reload - has to be answered with the patch stream.
The stream is sent from the collection queue when the client's CMSG_EXTENSION_INITIALIZED (0x561)
world-entry notice is handled, and a second notice inside the resend cooldown is throttled so one entry
cannot flood the client with the whole row set. Throttling has to defer that entry's stream, not discard
it: the first stream erases the display patch service's resend timer, so a throttled notice that only
records the cooldown leaves the late entry without its rows until the next relog and the client falls
back to its own Spell.dbc. Unlike the relog scenario this one never leaves the session, so a logout
cannot clear the cooldown state in between. This scenario waits for the first world entry's stream,
snapshots its row count for spell 500125, sends the world-entry notice again inside the cooldown and
asserts the count grows by one more row. Expected before: the throttled notice is consumed, nothing
retries and the count never grows. Expected after: the throttled notice is answered once the cooldown
expires and the late world entry receives the Mortal Form row again.

steps.label: Let the first world entry and its patch stream settle
Record the first world entry's row count inside the cooldown window
DISCRIMINATING: the throttled re-entry is still answered with one more row
